verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is a terminal app that ships its own local command set, so bundling git with submodule support is a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence documents a git command or submodule handling. The listed local commands (cat, grep, ls, cp, curl, scp, sftp, etc.) do not include git. Running git on a remote host over SSH, or inside Codespaces or VS Code, is a user-side or host-platform workaround and earns no credit.
